map.50mm：安全快门 = 1/50s（分母≈焦距）；200mm 需 1/200s，: 50mm: safe shutter = 1/50s (denominator ~ focal length); 200mm needs 1/200s, longer focal length shakes more easily.
map.5 档防抖：安全快门 = 1/(50×2^5) = 1/1600s 理论可更慢，: 5-stop stabilization: safe shutter = 1/(50 x 2^5) = 1/1600s, theoretically slower; in practice conservatively use 1/(focal length x stops) at 1/400s.
map.手持最快快门分母≈焦距（全幅等效），防抖可放宽 2–5 档但非绝对，仍看手稳与姿: Handheld fastest shutter denominator ~ focal length (full-frame equiv); stabilization relaxes 2-5 stops but not absolute, still depends on steady hands and stance.
map.裁切系数要算吗？: Should the crop factor be counted?
map.，如 APS-C 50mm 等效 75mm 则安全 1/75s 更稳。: , e.g. APS-C 50mm is equivalent 75mm so safe at 1/75s is steadier.
